forts.name: Red Fort
forts.description: The Red Fort is a historic fort in Delhi that served as the main residence of the Mughal Emperors. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and the site of India's Independence Day celebrations.

forts.name: Agra Fort
forts.description: Agra Fort is a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Agra. It was the main residence of the Mughal emperors until 1638 when the capital was shifted to Delhi.
facts: Shah Jahan imprisoned here by Aurangzeb

forts.name: Chittorgarh Fort
forts.description: Chittorgarh Fort is the largest fort in India and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It is associated with the legendary Rajput queen Rani Padmini.

forts.name: Mehrangarh Fort
forts.description: Mehrangarh Fort is one of the largest forts in India. It stands 410 feet above the city of Jodhpur and offers panoramic views.
facts: One of largest forts in India

forts.name: Golconda Fort
forts.description: Golconda Fort is a ruined fort and former capital of the Qutb Shahi dynasty. It was famous for its diamond trade, including the Kohinoor diamond.
facts: Acoustic system — clap at entrance heard at top

forts.name: Gwalior Fort
forts.description: Gwalior Fort is one of the most impregnable forts in India. It has been called 'the pearl amongst fortresses in India' by Babur.

forts.name: Jaisalmer Fort
forts.description: Jaisalmer Fort is one of the few living forts in the world. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and about 3,000 people still live inside the fort.

forts.name: Amber Fort
forts.description: Amber Fort is a UNESCO World Heritage Site near Jaipur. It is known for its artistic style blending Hindu and Mughal elements.
facts: Blend of Hindu and Mughal architecture

forts.name: Daulatabad Fort
forts.description: Daulatabad Fort is one of the most formidable forts in India. Muhammad bin Tughluq moved the capital of Delhi Sultanate here in 1327.
facts: Muhammad bin Tughluq moved capital here

forts.name: Purana Qila
forts.description: Purana Qila (Old Fort) is one of the oldest forts in Delhi. It is believed to be built on the site of Indraprastha, the capital of the Pandavas.
facts: Believed to be site of Indraprastha
Built by Humayun and Sher Shah Suri
